channel.desc: Patrick Brosnan, security expert and former NYPD detective, on the recent and deadly ICE and law enforcement activity in Minnesota. Christian Toto, founder of Hollywood in Toto, on the latest Oscar nominations and the current state of faith-based filmmaking. And, a classic World Over interview with the late Cardinal John O'Connor to commemorate our 30th year. (60 minutes).
